source.text_it: Circolando con pneumatici a pressione inferiore a quella consigliata dalla casa costruttrice si ha maggior consumo di carburante

records.localized_text: Driving with tyre pressure below the manufacturer's recommendation increases fuel consumption.

source.text_it: Circolando con pneumatici a pressione inferiore a quella consigliata dalla casa costruttrice il battistrada si consuma maggiormente ai lati

records.localized_text: Driving with tyre pressure below the manufacturer's recommendation causes greater wear at the edges of the tread.

source.text_it: Circolando con pneumatici a pressione inferiore a quella consigliata dalla casa costruttrice, in caso di strada bagnata, aumenta il pericolo di aquaplaning

records.localized_text: Driving with tyre pressure below the manufacturer's recommendation increases the risk of aquaplaning on wet roads.

source.text_it: Circolando con pneumatici a pressione inferiore a quella consigliata dalla casa costruttrice è minore la stabilità del veicolo

records.localized_text: Driving with tyre pressure below the manufacturer's recommendation reduces vehicle stability.

source.text_it: Circolando con pneumatici a pressione inferiore a quella consigliata dalla casa costruttrice si consumano maggiormente nella loro parte centrale

records.localized_text: Driving with tyre pressure below the manufacturer's recommendation causes greater wear in the centre of the tyres.

source.text_it: Circolando con pneumatici a pressione inferiore a quella consigliata dalla casa costruttrice si ottiene una migliore prestazione del veicolo

records.localized_text: Driving with tyre pressure below the manufacturer's recommendation improves vehicle performance.

source.text_it: Occorre verificare frequentemente la pressione di gonfiaggio dei pneumatici

records.localized_text: Tyre inflation pressure must be checked frequently.

source.text_it: Occorre verificare frequentemente che la pressione dei pneumatici sia quella indicata dal costruttore

records.localized_text: Tyre pressure must be checked frequently to ensure it matches the manufacturer's specification.

source.text_it: Occorre verificare frequentemente l'efficienza dell'impianto di illuminazione

records.localized_text: The lighting system must be checked frequently for proper operation.

source.text_it: Occorre verificare frequentemente l'efficienza dell'impianto frenante

records.localized_text: The braking system must be checked frequently for proper operation.

source.text_it: Occorre verificare frequentemente che i pneumatici siano sempre leggermente sgonfi

records.localized_text: It must be checked frequently that tyres are always slightly underinflated.

source.text_it: Occorre verificare frequentemente che i pneumatici siano più gonfi di quanto indicato dal costruttore

records.localized_text: It must be checked frequently that tyres are inflated above the manufacturer's specification.

source.text_it: Il proprietario di un ciclomotore ha l'obbligo di effettuare la revisione periodica al proprio veicolo a quattro anni dalla immissione in circolazione

records.localized_text: A moped owner must have the vehicle periodically inspected four years after it enters circulation.

source.text_it: Il proprietario di un ciclomotore ha l'obbligo di effettuare la revisione periodica al proprio veicolo ogni due anni successivamente alla prima revisione

records.localized_text: A moped owner must have the vehicle periodically inspected every two years after its first inspection.

source.text_it: Il proprietario di un ciclomotore ha l'obbligo di effettuare la revisione periodica al proprio veicolo ogni anno

records.localized_text: A moped owner must have the vehicle periodically inspected every year.

source.text_it: Il proprietario di un ciclomotore ha l'obbligo di effettuare la revisione periodica al proprio veicolo ad ogni nuova immatricolazione

records.localized_text: A moped owner must have the vehicle periodically inspected whenever it is newly registered.

source.text_it: Per mantenere i freni efficienti è necessario sottoporre a periodici controlli il consumo degli elementi frenanti

records.localized_text: To keep brakes effective, wear of braking components must be checked periodically.

source.text_it: Per mantenere i freni efficienti è necessario sottoporre a periodici controlli il livello dell'olio dei freni

records.localized_text: To keep brakes effective, the brake fluid level must be checked periodically.

source.text_it: Per mantenere i freni efficienti è necessario sottoporre a periodici controlli la corsa della leva che li comanda

records.localized_text: To keep brakes effective, the travel of the operating lever must be checked periodically.

source.text_it: Per mantenere i freni efficienti è necessario sottoporre a periodici controlli i cerchioni delle ruote

records.localized_text: To keep brakes effective, wheel rims must be checked periodically.

source.text_it: Per mantenere i freni efficienti è necessario sottoporre a periodici controlli la composizione chimica del liquido idraulico dei freni

records.localized_text: To keep brakes effective, the chemical composition of the hydraulic brake fluid must be checked periodically.

source.text_it: Per mantenere i freni efficienti è necessario sottoporre a periodici controlli la struttura del pneumatico

records.localized_text: To keep brakes effective, tyre structure must be checked periodically.

source.text_it: Quando si frena con un ciclomotore su una superficie stradale asciutta bisogna utilizzare sia il freno anteriore che quello posteriore

records.localized_text: When braking a moped on a dry road surface, both front and rear brakes must be used.

source.text_it: Quando si frena con un ciclomotore su una superficie stradale asciutta bisogna azionare entrambi i comandi dei freni

records.localized_text: When braking a moped on a dry road surface, both brake controls must be operated.

source.text_it: Quando si frena con un ciclomotore su una superficie stradale asciutta bisogna evitare sempre frenate brusche

records.localized_text: When braking a moped on a dry road surface, harsh braking must always be avoided.

rows.text: Insufficient pressure increases tyre deformation and rolling resistance, so the engine consumes more fuel.
evidence: https://www.nhtsa.gov/sites/nhtsa.gov/files/fmvss/TFECIP%2520Final%2520Rule.pdf, p. 36: minore pressione aumenta deformazione e resistenza al rotolamento, riducendo l’efficienza del carburante.

rows.text: With insufficient pressure, the tread tends to wear sooner at the shoulders, or sides.
evidence: https://www.michelinman.com/auto/auto-tips-and-advice/tire-pressure/auto/auto-tips-and-advice/tire-pressure/what-tire-pressure: la pressione insufficiente può causare usura prematura sulle spalle.

rows.text: Insufficient pressure can make a tyre lose contact with the wet road and slide on a film of water.
evidence: https://www.nhtsa.gov/sites/nhtsa.gov/files/tirepressure-fmvss-138.pdf: la pressione insufficiente aumenta la probabilità di aquaplaning; contano anche velocità e profondità dell’acqua.

rows.text: An underinflated tyre flexes excessively and makes handling less precise, reducing stability.
evidence: https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/advice/change-tyres/flat-tyre: la pressione insufficiente provoca eccessiva flessione e compromette la maneggevolezza.

rows.text: Insufficient pressure tends to wear the tread shoulders most, not the centre.
evidence: https://www.michelinman.com/auto/auto-tips-and-advice/tire-pressure/auto/auto-tips-and-advice/tire-pressure/what-tire-pressure: la pressione insufficiente può causare usura prematura sulle spalle.

rows.text: Pressure that is too low does not improve performance: it can impair handling and increase wear.
evidence: https://africa.michelin.com/en/motorbike/advice-motorbike/tyre-care/motorcycle-tyre-pressure-guide: la corretta pressione favorisce la maneggevolezza; pressione insufficiente può causare usura prematura.

rows.text: Pressure can fall with use. Checking it regularly when the tyres are cold helps keep it at the prescribed value.
evidence: https://africa.michelin.com/en/motorbike/advice-motorbike/tyre-care/motorcycle-tyre-pressure-guide: controllare regolarmente la pressione a freddo.

rows.text: Use the pressure specified by the manufacturer for the vehicle and load; regular checks allow pressure loss to be corrected.
evidence: https://www.nhtsa.gov/summer-driving-tips: gonfiare alla pressione raccomandata dal costruttore; https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/advice/change-tyres/flat-tyre: controlli regolari individuano perdite di pressione.

rows.text: Checking the lights reveals faults that impair visibility and the vehicle’s signals.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/check-vehicle-safe: verificare prima di guidare che tutte le luci funzionino.

rows.text: Frequent checks can reveal faults before they impair the vehicle’s ability to stop.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/check-vehicle-safe: verificare prima di guidare il funzionamento dei freni.

rows.text: Tyres should not be kept underinflated: inflate them to the pressure specified by the manufacturer.
evidence: https://www.nhtsa.gov/summer-driving-tips: usare la pressione raccomandata dal costruttore.

rows.text: Do not routinely inflate above the prescribed value: use the manufacturer’s pressure for the load conditions.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/annex-6-vehicle-maintenance-safety-and-security: pressione insufficiente o eccessiva compromette freni e sterzo; https://www.nhtsa.gov/summer-driving-tips: seguire la pressione raccomandata.

rows.text: For a moped, the first periodic inspection is due in the fourth year, by the end of the month of first registration.
evidence: https://mit.gov.it/revisione-periodica-veicoli: prima revisione nel quarto anno entro il mese della prima immatricolazione; comprende i ciclomotori.

rows.text: After the first inspection, periodic inspections are due every two years, by the end of the month corresponding to the last inspection.
evidence: https://mit.gov.it/revisione-periodica-veicoli: per i ciclomotori le revisioni successive sono biennali.

rows.text: A moped’s ordinary periodic inspection is not annual: after the first, it is repeated every two years.
evidence: https://mit.gov.it/revisione-periodica-veicoli: prima revisione dopo quattro anni e successive ogni due per i ciclomotori.

rows.text: Periodic inspections follow their own schedule: first in the fourth year and then every two years, not automatically at every new registration.
evidence: https://mit.gov.it/revisione-periodica-veicoli: indica le scadenze periodiche dei ciclomotori; https://www.mit.gov.it/nfsmitgov/files/media/normativa/2017-05/decreto%20ministeriale_protocollo_214_19-05-2017.pdf art. 5: distingue la visita e prova dalla revisione periodica.

rows.text: Brake pads and other braking components wear down; checking them allows replacement before they become too worn.
evidence: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/5fa19b098fa8f5789445b2e9/Transaidetal-2020-MotorcycleAssociationsManual-Generic-AfCAP-RAF2114A-190524.pdf, p. 18: controllo dell’indicatore di usura; https://cdn.powersports.honda.com/documentum/MWOM/ml.remawmom.2020_31mke710_crf450x.pdf: controllare periodicamente lo spessore delle pastiglie.

rows.text: On hydraulic systems, check the fluid level: if it is low, check for wear and possible leaks.
evidence: https://cdn.powersports.honda.com/documentum/MWOM/ml.remawmom.2010_31men6600_crf450r.pdf, p. 88: livello basso, usura delle pastiglie e controllo perdite.

rows.text: Excessive lever travel can indicate a fault in the system; checking it helps identify the problem.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/mot-inspection-manual-for-motorcycles/1-brakes, § 1.1.2: controllo corsa leva; https://cdn.powersports.honda.com/documentum/MWOM/ml.remawmom.2010_31men6600_crf450r.pdf, p. 88: corsa eccessiva può indicare aria nel circuito.

rows.text: Checking the rims concerns wheel safety; it is not a specific check of the braking system. To keep the brakes effective, their condition, operation and controls are checked.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/motorcycle-parts-checked-at-an-mot/motorcycle-parts-checked-at-an-mot, §§ 2.3 e 2.5: distingue controlli di ruote e pneumatici da quelli di freni e comandi.

rows.text: Routine maintenance does not require chemical analysis: check the fluid level and condition and replace it according to the manufacturer’s schedule.
evidence: https://cdn.powersports.honda.com/documentum/MWOM/ml.remawmom.2010_31men6600_crf450r.pdf, p. 88: controllo livello e perdite; https://cdn.powersports.honda.com/documentum/MWOM/ml.remawmom.2020_31mke710_crf450x.pdf: prevede la sostituzione periodica del liquido.

rows.text: Checking the tyre structure concerns the tyre; it is not a specific check of the braking system. Tyres remain important for grip; brake condition, operation and controls are checked to keep the brakes effective.
evidence: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/motorcycle-parts-checked-at-an-mot/motorcycle-parts-checked-at-an-mot, §§ 2.3 e 2.5: controlli distinti per pneumatici e freni.
https://content.tfl.gov.uk/tfl-urban-motorcycle-design-handbook.pdf, § 2.2.1: l’aderenza dei pneumatici alla strada è essenziale per stabilità e controllo della motocicletta.

rows.text: Using both brakes progressively applies braking to both wheels and helps maintain control.
evidence: https://msf-usa.org/quick-video-tips-long-format/stops/: esercitare arresti progressivi usando entrambi i freni.

rows.text: Operating both controls progressively uses both the front and rear brakes while maintaining control.
evidence: https://msf-usa.org/quick-video-tips-long-format/stops/: esercitare arresti progressivi usando entrambi i freni.

rows.text: Even on dry roads, brake progressively to avoid locking the wheels. In an emergency, react quickly and apply the brakes firmly without locking them.
evidence: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/5fa19888e90e07042c1e10f0/Transaidetal-2020-InstructorsManualCBCMotorcycleRiderTraining-Generic-AfCAP-RAF2114A-190524__1_.pdf, p. 42: in emergenza reagire rapidamente e frenare progressivamente senza bloccare le ruote; https://msf-usa.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/MSF-You-and-Your-Motorcycle-Riding-Tips-2023.pdf, p. 35: frenata massima senza bloccaggio.

prior_review_findings.author: gpt-6.1-terra / 01a1ea24-451a-7662-bfa3-04fba4771d48
issues: 27012: The explanation says rim checks do not replace brake checks, but the question does not claim they do; it does not explain why checking wheel rims is not a specific check of the braking system required to maintain the brakes. Clarify the distinction while preserving the need to check rims for wheel safety; the cited GOV.UK motorcycle inspection guidance distinguishes wheel checks (§ 2.3) from braking checks (§ 2.5).

27014: The explanation says brake components must also be checked, which is compatible with the false statement and does not explain why checking tyre structure is not a specific check of the braking system. Clarify the distinction while preserving the importance of tyres for road grip; GOV.UK motorcycle inspection guidance distinguishes tyre checks (§ 2.3) from braking checks (§ 2.5).
